before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load and aggregate the CSV data
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
region_revenue = df.groupby('region', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.bar(region_revenue['region'], region_revenue['revenue'])
ax.set_xlabel('Region')
ax.set_ylabel('Total revenue')
ax.set_title('Total Revenue by Region')
# Bars must start at zero, so do not use the requested truncated y-axis.
ax.set_ylim(0, 45000)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
